summary: Haleon plc filed a routine Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) furnishing its monthly Total Voting Rights and Capital disclosure as of 30 September 2026. The company reported 8,808,341,409 ordinary shares of 0.01 each issued, of which 11,763,163 are held in treasury, leaving 8,796,578,246 ordinary shares with voting rights. The figure serves as the denominator for shareholders' FCA Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules notification obligations. Company Secretary Amanda Mellor signed. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, price, or regulatory clock is stated; this is purely a standing transparency notice with no special-situations element or risk-arb angle.
